free_tier.stated: Free-tier routes exist, with the free-tier models glm-5.3-flash-modal and deepseek-v4.1-flash-modal capped at 16,384 output tokens because they share a fixed concurrency pool; paid models run from USD 0.165 to USD 0.33 per 1M input tokens.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: an OpenAI-compatible base URL with a model list at GET /v1/models
chaining: the two-minute window on large-context requests is the scarce link, and the cap is silent because max_tokens is reduced rather than rejected

limits.value: one 500k+ token request per 2 minutes on the free tier
free-tier routes are capped at 16,384 max_tokens

identity_cost.detail: signup is required and the page states no card for the free-tier routes

reliability_note: an over-cap max_tokens is reduced silently instead of refused, so a run can return shorter output than it asked for

evidence.proved: free-tier routes are capped at 16,384 max_tokens on a shared concurrency pool and large-context requests are limited to one per two minutes
evidence.quote: Every model in the catalog accepts up to 131,072 output tokens. The two free-tier routes, `glm-5.3-flash-modal` and `deepseek-v4.1-flash-modal`, are capped at 16,384 instead, because they share a fixed concurrency pool. A `max_tokens` above the cap is reduced to it rather than rejected, and each model reports its own figure as `max_completion_tokens` in `GET /v1/models`.
